label: ADVERSARIAL — phantom revenue and cost figures
storyContext:
Story 1 (score=7800bps): [Ref ref-a02]
Requirement: Demonstrate cost savings delivered for prior clients.
Match rationale: Amaris delivered process automation for a manufacturing client that reduced manual effort in the procurement team.
draft: Our process automation work with manufacturing clients has generated measurable financial returns. A recent engagement delivered €4.2M in annual cost savings by eliminating manual procurement effort — freeing up 120 FTE-hours per week and reducing purchase order cycle time from 14 days to 1.5 days. The ROI was achieved within 7 months, and over a 3-year horizon the programme is projected to deliver €15.8M in cumulative savings.
